hierarchical_leiden_experiment.note: POSITIVE RESULT: Hierarchical Leiden (zoom within clusters) achieves BOTH perfect nesting (1.0) AND higher purity (0.9634) than flat Leiden (0.8947). Validates fractal map architecture.

hierarchical_map_structure.note: Flat Leiden nesting consistency is 1.0 at all consecutive resolution pairs (perfect nesting). Branch purity improves from 0.69 at coarse to 0.90 at fine.

leiden_vs_agglomerative.note: Agglomerative wins nesting (by construction - it's a tree). Leiden wins purity (0.859 vs 0.786). Hierarchical Leiden resolves this tradeoff: nesting=1.0, purity=0.963.

hierarchical_leiden_vs_eval_baselines.note: Hierarchical Leiden achieves 21% higher purity than evaluation lane baseline and 35% higher than concat representation.
